# Egern

> Egern is an iOS, iPadOS and macOS network tool for proxying, intercepting and
> modifying traffic. This repository is a machine-readable snapshot of the official
> documentation at https://egernapp.com/docs, published as Markdown for LLM and
> agent consumption.

Official documentation: https://egernapp.com/docs
Chinese documentation: https://egernapp.com/zh-CN/docs
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1616105820

Every page is a Markdown file under `.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/` and `.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/`.
`llms-full.txt` contains all English pages concatenated in this order.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/intro.md): What Egern is: traffic logging, rule types, policy groups, supported protocols, scripting.
- [FAQ](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about Egern behaviour and configuration.
- [URL Scheme](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/url-scheme.md): egern:// URL schemes for automation and shortcuts.

## Configuration

- [Full configuration example](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-example.md): A complete Profile.yaml with every global field annotated.
- [Proxies](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-proxies.md): Proxy definitions and protocols: HTTP, SOCKS5, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, VLESS, VMess.
- [Policy groups](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-policy_groups.md): Policy groups, group types, filters, flattening and subscriptions.
- [Rules](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-rules.md): Routing rule syntax and rule sets, including remote rule set references.
- [DNS](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-dns.md): Bootstrap, upstreams, forward rules, proxy DNS, block IPs, DoH/DoT/DoQ/DoH3.

## Scripting

- [JavaScript API](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/javascript-api.md): The script runtime API: ctx objects, HTTP helpers, persistence, notifications, SSH.
- [Scriptings](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-scriptings.md): Script configuration: http_request, http_response, schedule, generic and network scripts.
- [Environment variables](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-env.md): Environment variables exposed to scripts and modules.
- [Widgets](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-widgets.md): Widget DSL for home screen widgets and script-driven panels.

## Traffic rewriting

- [URL rewrites](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-url_rewrites.md): URL rewrite rules for MITM traffic.
- [Header rewrites](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-header_rewrites.md): Request and response header rewriting.
- [Body rewrites](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-body_rewrites.md): Request and response body rewriting, including JQ expressions.
- [HTTP captures](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-http_captures.md): Capturing and exporting HTTP traffic.
- [Modules](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/configuration-modules.md): Modules, remote module references and argument substitution.

## Tutorials

- [Proxy tutorial](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/example-proxy.md): Step-by-step setup of a proxy configuration.
- [HTTP sniffer tutorial](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/en/example-http-traffic-sniffer.md): Step-by-step HTTPS interception setup with certificates.

## 中文文档

- [产品介绍](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/intro.md): Egern 是什么：流量记录、规则类型、策略组、支持的协议与脚本能力。
- [常见问题](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/faq.md): Egern 使用与配置的常见问题。
- [URL Scheme](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/url-scheme.md): 用于自动化与捷径的 egern:// URL Scheme。
- [完整配置示例](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-example.md): 带全局字段注释的完整 Profile.yaml 示例。
- [代理节点](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-proxies.md): 代理节点定义与协议：HTTP、SOCKS5、Shadowsocks、Trojan、Hysteria2、VLESS、VMess。
- [策略组](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-policy_groups.md): 策略组、组类型、节点筛选、flatten 与订阅。
- [分流规则](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-rules.md): 分流规则语法与规则集，包括远程规则集引用。
- [DNS](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-dns.md): Bootstrap、上游 DNS、Forward 规则、代理 DNS、block_ips 与 DoH/DoT/DoQ/DoH3。
- [JavaScript API](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/javascript-api.md): 脚本运行时 API：ctx 对象、HTTP 请求、持久化存储、通知与 SSH。
- [脚本](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-scriptings.md): 脚本配置：http_request、http_response、schedule、generic 与 network 五种脚本类型。
- [环境变量](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-env.md): 脚本与模块可读取的环境变量。
- [小组件](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-widgets.md): 用于主屏小组件与脚本面板的 Widget DSL。
- [URL 重写](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-url_rewrites.md): 针对 MITM 流量的 URL 重写规则。
- [HTTP 头重写](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-header_rewrites.md): 请求头与响应头重写。
- [HTTP 正文重写](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-body_rewrites.md): 请求正文与响应正文重写，包括 JQ 表达式。
- [HTTP 抓包](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-http_captures.md): HTTP 流量的抓取与导出。
- [模块](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/configuration-modules.md): 模块、远程模块引用与参数替换。
- [代理教程](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/example-proxy.md): 从零配置代理的分步教程。
- [抓包教程](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/docs/zh-CN/example-http-traffic-sniffer.md): 配置证书与 HTTPS 中间人抓包的分步教程。

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every English page in one file, for context windows that can hold the whole documentation.
- [.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/skills/egern-docs/SKILL.md): agent skill definition that routes questions to the right page.
